speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with progressive difficulty walking, urinary incontinence, and speech difficulties. To begin our investigation, on a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate your current balance and coordination, and have you noticed any specific muscle weakness?

speaker: Patient
text: 54-year-old male. The patient has been experiencing a gradual difficulty in walking over the past 3 months, requiring wheelchair assistance for the last month. Additionally, there is a history of urinary incontinence for 1 year and recent onset of speech slurring making communication challenging.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: ALS (Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis). Based on the classic triad of progressive weakness, urinary incontinence, and bulbar symptoms (slurred speech) in a 54-year-old male, I am confident in this diagnosis without needing further testing.
